## Get Med international and Expansion videos

parameters.query:
SELECT
    id,
    message_type,
    content_text,
    media_url,
    timestamp
FROM maytapi_bbs_messages
WHERE timestamp = '2026-05-27T17:16:00.000Z'
ORDER BY timestamp;
